full_prompt_en: A square black-and-white coloring-book drawing shows an elaborate hilltop town of clustered towers, steep roofs, and narrow streets beneath several floating balloons. The scene fills nearly the entire page with fine outlines on white paper. At the far left, a tall cylindrical tower rises from a dense group of smaller buildings, its pointed conical roof nearly touching the top edge. Across the center, layered facades, archways, chimneys, and spires step upward toward a larger castle-like complex on the high right ridge. The buildings are drawn in many small rectangular stones and roof tiles, with dark crosshatching in recesses and under overhangs. A broad street or path enters from the lower center and winds between the crowded houses toward the distant hill. Tiny human figures appear along the route, giving the town a sense of scale without becoming focal subjects. In the pale upper sky, one large striped balloon floats near the center-left, with smaller balloon outlines and a tiny bird farther away. Soft cloud shapes and distant structures are left lighter, while the near walls and tower roofs receive denser linework. The page has no filled color areas; depth comes from overlapping contours, varying line weight, and tight clusters of hatching. Even light falls across the white paper, preserving the open shapes intended for coloring and making the dark ink marks crisp. The overall composition is richly detailed and upward moving, with a clear path through architectural density and airy balloon shapes above.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形黑白涂色书线稿呈现一座精细的山顶小镇，塔楼、陡屋顶和窄街密集，头顶漂着几个热气球。场景以白纸上的细轮廓几乎填满整页。最左侧，一座高圆柱塔从密集小房屋中升起，尖圆锥屋顶几乎碰到顶边。中央层叠立面、拱门、烟囱与尖塔逐级向右侧高坡上的更大城堡形建筑抬升。房屋上画出许多小矩形石块和屋瓦，凹处和檐下有深色交叉排线。一条宽街或小路从下方中央进入，在拥挤房屋间弯向远山。路上出现细小的人影，提供城镇尺度，却不成为焦点。浅色上部天空中，中央略偏左有一只大条纹热气球，更远处还有较小气球轮廓和一只小鸟。柔云形和远处结构线条更浅，近处墙体与塔楼屋顶排线更密。纸页没有填满的色块；纵深来自交叠轮廓、线条粗细变化与密集排线簇。均匀光铺过白纸，保留可供上色的开放形状，使深墨线迹清晰。整体构图细节丰富而向上延展，一条明确小路穿过建筑密度，空气中的气球形体浮在上方。
style_prompt_en: The page is composed of crisp black outlines, fine hatch marks, and generous unfilled white areas. Intricate clusters build depth through overlapping contours and changes in line density rather than tonal paint. Near forms carry tight stone-like texture and stronger edges, while distant layers thin to pale, airy marks. Even page light keeps every open shape legible for color, with no heavy solid fill to close the image. Tall vertical beats are linked by lower winding lines and small floating accents above. The result is ornate and exploratory while retaining the clean structure of printable line art.
style_prompt_zh: 纸页由清晰黑轮廓、细排线和充足未填白色构成。繁复簇群通过交叠轮廓与线密度变化，而非明暗颜料来建立纵深。近处形体有紧密似石纹和较强边缘，远层则淡为轻盈线迹。均匀纸面光让每个开放形状都可辨、可上色，没有厚实填黑封住画面。高竖向节拍由下方蜿蜒线条连接，上方再点缀小型悬浮重音。结果华丽而富探索感，同时保有可印制线稿的干净结构。
theme_en: An intricate castle town under floating balloons as black-and-white line art
theme_zh: 黑白线稿中，热气球飘在繁复城堡小镇上方
name: Coloring book page
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
